source: Transcribed from DCADS/1984/DCADS_TSS.pdf, the Electronic Records Technical Specifications Summary, which lists Record_Length and Record_Count for every DCADS data file. The same PDF is duplicated in 29 fiscal-year folders; one copy was read. Values here are the declared record counts, used by 06_verify_dcads_parse.py as a check independent of file-size arithmetic.
note: MPCF FY1966-1975 record counts are not transcribed: the summary covers the DCADS series and the MPCF counts were not read off it. Files absent from this table fall back to a size divided by record length check, and the verifier reports which basis it used.
uncompressed_bytes_note: For the zipped years the byte count is the uncompressed member size declared by the summary, which is what the extracted file should match.
